source_block.divergence: BORI CE and the Ganguli vulgate both tell Durvāsā’s arrival after Draupadi has cleaned the Akṣayapātra; Krishna eats a remaining grain and the sage’s hunger is satisfied far away. Gita Press Gorakhpur narrates the same arc. Section numbering differs (CE vs vulgate English); the beats agree.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI overlap: the Akṣayapātra miracle itself — vessel feeds until Draupadi finishes; Durvāsā arrives hungry; Draupadi prays; Krishna takes the last grain; Durvāsā turns back content. Ganguli Vana Parva for English beat map.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology Durvasa (fierce but not photoreal horror). Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or this episode’s plate-wide-gold as Imagine refs. Vessel prop lock: stills/_locks/akshayapatra.jpg.
